title: Hello, World!
description:
Write a function `greet(name)` that returns the string `"Hello, {name}!"`.

The function should take a single string argument and return the greeting. Do not print — return the string.
hint: Use an f-string to format the greeting: `f"Hello, {name}!"`
outputExplanation: greet("Alice") returns "Hello, Alice!" — a simple string formatting exercise.
